plans.title: Stop the crash-capture sweep costing 30 s of every boot, and delete the four finalizers that can never fire
plans.brief: FINDINGS PERF-L4-01 (lane-4) and CORRECTNESS-04 (lane-3), both CONFIRMED by adversarial checkers. Full text: plans/_audit/2026-09-23-opus/lane-4.findings.md and lane-3.findings.md under those ids; verdicts and corrections: verify-PERF-L4-01-repro.md, verify-PERF-L4-01-design.md, verify-a-batch-05.md. FACTS: Main/SubModule.cs:194-210 (at b2e387db, read with git show) attaches Native2ManagedPatcher.AttachAll (Main/Features/CrashReport/Hooks/Native2ManagedPatcher.cs:72-95) which Harmony-patches 247 static methods of every *CallbacksGenerated type; the taom_debug logs in the game's bin/Win64_Shipping_Client/Logs show a 29 to 33 s gap between the [SaveDefiners] line and 'Native2Managed: attached 247 Finalizer(s)' on 30 of 30 current boots; 0 of 30 logs ever captured a bridge-origin exception. The MCM toggles at SubModule.cs:195 and :201 are DEAD at that point: CrashReportSettings.Instance is null during OnSubModuleLoad (MCM assigns its provider later, in its own OnBeforeInitialModuleScreenSetAsRoot), so both fall through to '?? true' and no player can switch the cost off; the MCM hint text (CrashReportSettings.cs:21,31), Native2ManagedPatcher.cs:16 and docs/features/crash-report.md:277-278 all wrongly claim zero cost or 'disable via MCM'. DECIDED POSTURE TO KEEP: the capture stays ON by default (CrashReportSettings.cs:7-9 records it; docs/features/hero-race.md:242-243 and docs/reference/engine/gauntletui-viewmodel-screen.md:111-112 rely on the sweep as a log-and-swallow safety net), so the plan must NOT flip the default; flipping it is Mike's decision, recorded as an open question. DIRECTION: (1) wrap AttachAll in a Stopwatch and log elapsed ms (proves the cost, step 1); (2) replace 'every static method of every generated type' with an explicit allowlist of the callback families the two docs rely on, derived by reading those docs and the generated types via taom-src (STOP if the allowlist cannot be derived with evidence); (3) make the toggle honest: either read the persisted MCM value without MCM (the setting's json lives under Documents/Mount and Blade II Bannerlord/Configs/ModSettings; verify path and format from the MCM decompile) or move the gate to a point where Instance is non-null, whichever keeps capture during the load window; correct the hint text and docs. Remember the trap: a changed MCM default needs a renamed setting because json2 persists old values (orientation.md 'Persisted MCM defaults'). CORRECTNESS-04: Main/Features/CrashReport/Hooks/Patch37_CrashReport.cs:45-51, 63-69, 104-110, 113-119 put finalizers on four EMPTY base virtuals (ScriptComponentBehavior.OnTick, MissionView.OnMissionScreenTick, MissionBehavior.OnMissionTick, MBSubModuleBase.OnSubModuleLoad; v1.5.3 bodies empty or FailedAssert), so overrides never pass through them: delete the four, fix the '9 finalizers' comments and docs/features/crash-report.md:63,:284,:285, add a test that Patch37 targets are not empty virtuals, and make the per-occurrence suppression log line logarithmic (1, 10, 100) using CrashBundleThrottle's existing count (CrashBundleThrottle.cs:65-66). SubModule.cs is single-owner and another session has uncommitted edits to it: if the fix needs SubModule.cs, list the exact lines in scope; the executor works on a branch from b2e387db, so that is allowed on the branch.

plans.title: Stop PatchShield re-shielding the 247 callback shims at the first game start
plans.brief: FINDING PERF-FU-PATCHSHIELD-01 (orchestrator follow-up, CONFIRMED; the orchestrator re-read diag.log: pass 2 at 13:50:31.642, '+372 new' at 13:51:40.999 = 69.4 s; a second game start 13:54:52.950 to 13:55:19.490 = 26.5 s). Full text and measurements: plans/_audit/2026-09-23-opus/followup-patchshield.md. FACTS: Dependencies/SubModule.cs:288 (b2e387db) runs PatchShield.Install() pass 2 inside OnGameInitializationFinished, i.e. synchronously on the main thread inside the first game-loading screen of each process (the 'main menu reached' label at :276 and the doc at :267-272 are wrong). Dependencies/Foundation/PatchShield.cs:165,176-232 walks Harmony.GetAllPatchedMethods() and calls harmony.Patch(method, finalizer) once per not-yet-shielded method; its only target filters are TAOM-declared targets (:184-190), the ExcludedTargetNamespacePrefixes list (:60-69: TaleWorlds.GauntletUI, TaleWorlds.TwoDimension, TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade.GauntletUI) and SaveShield targets (:210). Main's Native2ManagedPatcher (Main/Features/CrashReport/Hooks/Native2ManagedPatcher.cs:62-88) patches every static method of ManagedCallbacks.{Library,Core,Engine}CallbacksGenerated (45 + 114 + 88 = 247) before pass 2, so about 247 of pass 2's 372 attaches re-shield those shims; Harmony 2.4.2 rebuilds and re-detours the whole replacement per Patch call (no batch API), at about 186 ms per attach on this machine since 2026-06-12 (5-10 ms before; environmental, cause UNVERIFIED). diag.log: 0 PatchShield swallows and 0 unpatches in 466 sessions. PatchShield's rescue is a no-op on those shims (finalizer-only owners; rescue strips prefix/postfix/transpiler only, PatchShield.cs:398-400) and its swallow duplicates Native2Managed's HandleAndSwallow (Main/Features/CrashReport/CrashReportPatchHelper.cs:29-53). DIRECTION: (1) add "ManagedCallbacks" to the excluded namespace prefixes with a comment citing the Native2Managed overlap and the #331 hot-layer rationale; if cheap, move the list into PatchShieldPolicy and add a PatchShieldPolicyTests case (TDD: a failing policy test that a ManagedCallbacks target is excluded). (2) append elapsed ms and ms per attach to the 'shield pass' log line (PatchShield.cs:237), since diag.log ships in crash bundles (CrashBundleWriter.cs:48). (3) correct the Dependencies/SubModule.cs:267-276 label and doc. OUT OF SCOPE, record as follow-ups: skipping targets whose every owner is protected (a posture change for Mike); the side lead that TAOM's Harmony id 'com.taom.mod' matches no CompiledProtectedOwnerPrefixes entry (PatchShieldPolicy.cs:23-63,84-95), so the rescue path could strip TAOM's own prefixes/postfixes/transpilers after a missing-API exception (PatchShield.cs:378-401): UNVERIFIED, needs its own investigation; and the machine's 30x per-Patch tax (an environment item for Mike, not a repo defect). Coordinate with plan 006 (same 247 methods): 006 narrows the Native2Managed sweep; this exclusion helps regardless of 006 and of persisted MCM values. Dependencies/ is a separate project (Dependencies/TAOM.Dependencies.csproj) with its own tests: find them with git grep PatchShieldPolicyTests.

plans.title: Make the binding gate fail loudly instead of passing by skipping
plans.brief: FINDINGS TEST-L5-01 and TEST-L5-02 (lane-5), CONFIRMED by two lenses; seed F2. Full text: lane-5.findings.md; verdicts: verify-TEST-L5-01-repro.md, verify-TEST-L5-01-design.md, verify-b-batch-01.md. FACTS: no runsettings exists; TAOM.Tests/Migration/GameAssemblies.cs:111-122 (ResolveGameDir) reads only the BANNERLORD_OVERRIDE_DIR / BANNERLORD_GAME_DIR environment variables, and the BindingVerification tests call Assert.Inconclusive when it is missing (GameModelOverrideBindingTests.cs:48-49, HarmonyPatchBindingTests.cs:41-42), and also below discovery floors (HarmonyPatchBindingTests.cs:46-50 fewer than 30 patch types; GameModelOverrideBindingTests.cs:52-53 fewer than 20 models). Probe: a prebuilt test bin run by dotnet vstest without the variable printed 'Passed! Failed 0, Passed 33, Skipped 335' exit 0; the same run with a runsettings containing <MSTest><MapInconclusiveToFailed>true</MapInconclusiveToFailed></MSTest> failed all 335 (MSTest.TestAdapter 3.1.1 honours it). The trx records Inconclusive as outcome NotExecuted with Counters inconclusive=0. .claude/hooks/notify-test-results.sh:49-54 parses only Failed/Passed and would print PASSED. build.ps1:37-42 checks only $LASTEXITCODE. .claude/skills/verify-bindings/SKILL.md:27 claims the gate 'does not falsely pass' (false). DECIDED, KEEP: individual tests skip when the game or the Armory is absent (GameAssemblies.cs:19-21; docs/reviews/lessons/data-content-cultures.md:1588-1591); a GLOBAL MapInconclusiveToFailed would overturn that decision for every test, so DO NOT make it global. DIRECTION: (1) TEST-L5-02: GameAssemblies falls back to the game folder the BUILD used: emit [assembly: AssemblyMetadata("TaomGameFolder", "$(GameFolder)")] from TAOM.Tests.csproj and read it when the env vars are absent (TDD: failing test first); (2) add TAOM.Tests/binding-gate.runsettings with MapInconclusiveToFailed, used by the verify-bindings skill's command and by CI (not by default dotnet test), and make the discovery floors Assert.Fail rather than Inconclusive when the game dir IS resolved; (3) make notify-test-results.sh report skipped counts (harness change, needs a CHANGELOG entry and bash tools/test_hooks.sh); (4) correct verify-bindings SKILL.md:27 and give it the runsettings flag. Record in the plan that docs/reviews/rca-lord-identity-2026-08-29.md:72,77-80 lists 'Assert.Inconclusive is a pass' as still open: this plan closes the binding-gate half.

plans.title: Apply every Harmony patch category through one guarded helper
plans.brief: FINDING COMP-01 (lane-1), CONFIRMED by two lenses, impact recalibrated to MED. Full text: lane-1.findings.md; verdicts: verify-COMP-01-repro.md, verify-COMP-01-design.md. FACTS at b2e387db (read Main/SubModule.cs with git show b2e387db:Main/SubModule.cs): 64 bare _harmony.PatchCategory calls (13 in OnSubModuleLoad lines 111-628, 50 in OnGameInitializationFinished 1510-1745, 1 at 1922) and 20 hand-guarded ones. Harmony 2.4.2 PatchCategory has no catch: one class whose target does not resolve throws HarmonyException out of the SubModule hook. In OnSubModuleLoad the engine catches, logs and rethrows (Module.cs:204-220 in the v1.5.3 decompile): TAOM fails to boot. In the game-init batch the once-per-process flag is set at 1464-1465 BEFORE the batch; a throw aborts the rest of the batch (crash guards Patch65/82/84 included, plus the watchdogs at 1818/1831/1842, ManualPatchApplicator at 1869 and the Harmony census); Patch37's Module.OnApplicationTick finalizer swallows it, a crash bundle is written, and the load step retries every tick (for a saved game Game.LoadSaveGame(null) then throws each tick: a load that never finishes; for a new game TAOM returns early at 1464 and runs half-patched). SubModule.cs:187-189 and docs/features/crash-report.md:284 falsely claim Patch37 covers TAOM's own OnSubModuleLoad throws. No ADR or rule decides these stay bare; docs/reviews/lessons/harmony-il.md:172-188 prescribes per-category isolation. DIRECTION: a private TryPatch(string category) helper calling PatchCategory(typeof(SubModule).Assembly, category) explicitly (Harmony.PatchCategory(string) resolves the assembly from StackTrace frame 1, so an explicit assembly is required inside a helper), logging Error with the category and exception, collecting failures, and one red InformationMessage per phase listing failed categories (so a failed crash guard is never silent). Replace all 64 bare calls and fold the 20 hand-written try/catch blocks into it; keep the once-per-process flag (the batch now always completes). TDD: a test that a helper-applied category whose target cannot resolve is logged and does not stop the next category (model a fake category in the test assembly or test the helper through an injected apply delegate). Text tests that spell '.PatchCategory(' need updating (FieldCampWiringTests.cs:191 at least; grep all). Correct the two false comments. SubModule.cs is single-owner and another session has uncommitted edits in the main tree: the plan lists SubModule.cs explicitly in scope ON THE BRANCH and warns that merging needs a rebase over that session's edits.

plans.title: Make the four Stop reminders reach Claude and guard the live trunk against force pushes
plans.brief: FINDINGS DX-L6-06 and DX-L6-03 (lane-6), CONFIRMED. Full text: lane-6.findings.md; verdicts: verify-b-batch-05.md (DX-L6-06), verify-b-batch-04.md (DX-L6-03). FACTS: .claude/settings.json:204-229 registers four Stop hooks (check-changelog-updated.sh, check-deep-review.sh, check-verification-evidence.sh, check-version-tagged.sh); each prints its reminder with '>&2' and exits 0, and per .claude/rules/harness-facts.md 'Hook lifecycle' (vendor docs: stderr from a hook that exits 0 goes to the debug log only; Claude never sees it) none of them has ever reached Claude, while docs/reference/hooks-catalog.md presents them as active. Three of the four write a mute marker (check-deep-review.sh mutes on an agent-audit.log line instead). The documented way for a Stop hook to reach Claude is JSON on stdout {"decision":"block","reason":"..."}, and the payload's stop_hook_active flag must short-circuit to avoid a loop. DX-L6-03: .claude/hooks/validate-push.sh:115 protects only master|main|bannerlord-1.4.5; bannerlord-1.5.x, the branch the v2.0.29 and v2.0.30 tags live on, is unguarded (0 hits for 1.5.x in .claude/hooks); the matcher at .claude/settings.json:35,44 is Bash-only, so the PowerShell tool is unguarded too; GitHub protects neither branch. DIRECTION: convert each Stop reminder to the JSON block form with the stop_hook_active guard and a mute marker written after emitting (keep fail-open: any internal error exits 0 with no output); add a tools/test_hooks.sh check that Stop hooks never print a bare stderr reminder with exit 0; fix hooks-catalog.md rows; protect bannerlord-* in validate-push.sh; add a PowerShell matcher only if the existing hook can read a PowerShell payload safely (else record as follow-up). The GitHub ruleset (block force push and deletion on bannerlord-*) is an outward-facing change: the plan writes the exact steps for Mike and does NOT perform them. Harness edits require a CHANGELOG.md entry in the same commit and bash tools/test_hooks.sh green; the vendor behaviour must be proven live once per .claude/rules/hook-authoring.md 'Prove a gate live' (record how, since a subagent cannot end a session: a documented manual check for Mike is acceptable).

plans.title: Stop the loading-window trace walking the stack and flushing a log line every frame
plans.brief: FINDING PERF-L4-02 (lane-4), CONFIRMED, impact MED. Full text: lane-4.findings.md; verdict with corrected counts: verify-a-batch-05.md. FACTS: the LoadingWindow Disable postfix (LoadingWindow_Transitions_Patch.cs:30-35; find it with git grep) calls MapLoadTracer.TraceWithCallers, which walks 12 stack frames (MapLoadTracer.cs:62-82) and logs through FileLogger.LogInfo, which is durable (flushes; FileLogger.cs:85) and drains on the calling thread; the engine calls Disable every frame on the main menu, party screen and character creation, so taom_debug_2026-09-23_13-43-40.log holds 262,763 'LOADING-WINDOW lowered' lines (99.1% of its [MapLoad] lines; about 84 MB per 35-minute session) and those logs ship inside crash bundles. DIRECTION: a Prefix captures LoadingWindow.IsLoadingWindowActive into __state and the Postfix traces only when it was true (a real transition); optionally route the tracer through LogDebug (queued, not flushed). TDD: extract the decision (trace only on a true-to-false transition) into a testable static or service method and test it first. Verify the engine property name and its semantics with pwsh tools/taom-src.ps1 path LoadingWindow and quote the signature in the plan.

plans.title: Let non-git Bash calls skip the Python start-up in every Bash hook
plans.brief: FINDING DX-L6-02 (lane-6), CONFIRMED. Full text: lane-6.findings.md; verdict with the corrected prefilter: verify-b-batch-03.md. FACTS: 13 hook processes run per Bash call (10 PreToolUse(Bash) gates, 1 universal PreToolUse, 2 PostToolUse(Bash)); every Bash gate sources _pybin.sh first (its resolve runs at file scope, _pybin.sh:146, with a Python probe at :88-90) and then starts a second Python to parse the payload before testing for git; measured 219 to 360 ms per hook on a non-git 'ls' payload (2,834 ms serial; baseline.md), against a 49 ms bare bash spawn. The checker measured that a plain substring test [[ "$INPUT" == *git* ]] is a true superset (JSON does not escape ASCII letters) and passes about 17.8% of calls, so about 82% of Bash calls would skip the Python start-up. DIRECTION (step 1 only; the single-dispatcher step 2 fails the simplicity criterion for now): in each Bash-matched hook, read INPUT, and before sourcing _pybin.sh exit with the hook's normal allow output ('{}' for PreToolUse gates, nothing for PostToolUse) when the payload cannot concern that hook (no 'git' substring for git gates; for notify-test-results.sh and mark-verification-run.sh use their own trigger substrings such as 'dotnet test' or 'build.ps1', read each hook to find them). Keep every hook's fail-open contract and its registered timeout. Verify with bash tools/test_hooks.sh and by re-timing with the same method as baseline.md (5 runs each on a non-git payload; target under 80 ms per hook). Harness edits need a CHANGELOG.md entry in the same commit.

plans.title: Reset Enlistment's per-session clocks and caches on load and on a new campaign
plans.brief: FINDINGS seed F3 and CORRECTNESS-07 (lane-3), CONFIRMED; related COMP-02 (lane-1). Full text: BRIEF.md seed F3, lane-3.findings.md CORRECTNESS-07; verdicts: verify-a-batch-01.md, verify-a-batch-04.md, verify-a-batch-06.md (F3 section). FACTS: Main/Features/Enlistment/ServiceAttachmentService.cs:34 holds _settlementEntryHours, an absolute campaign hour on a Reuse.Singleton (EnlistmentIoC.cs:31), written at :41, cleared only at :231; IsWithinSettlementDwell (:43-44) treats a negative elapsed time as inside the dwell, and EnlistmentReconciler.cs:641 uses it to defer the exit sweep. ServiceMaintenanceService.ResetSessionCaches (:217-241) is the documented single reset point but never clears it, AND it is called only from OnGameLoaded (Main/Features/Enlistment/Hooks/EnlistmentBehavior.cs:115-122); OnNewGameCreated (:124-130) clears only the store, so a new campaign in the same process never reaches the reset at all. CORRECTNESS-07: EnlistmentWaitMenuPresenter (singleton, EnlistmentIoC.cs:55) keeps _lastOfferedAtHours (:67) tested at :132 and never reset, so after loading an earlier save or starting a new campaign the leave-on-arrival offer is suppressed; ArmyRhythmSnapshotService.Invalidate (:67-70) has zero callers (dead). The house rule is .claude/rules/csharp-architecture.md 'Singleton Services Holding Per-Campaign State MUST Have a Session-Reset Story' (every such singleton exposes ResetForNewSession; both the new-campaign and the load paths call it; *SessionResetTests). DIRECTION: scope to Enlistment: add ResetForNewSession to IServiceAttachmentService and to the wait-menu presenter, call them from ResetSessionCaches, and make the new-campaign path (OnNewGameCreated) call ResetSessionCaches too (check the entity-state and ordering constraints in EnlistmentBehavior before doing so; the store clear must still happen); decide whether to wire or delete the dead ArmyRhythmSnapshotService.Invalidate (delete if nothing needs it). TDD: failing tests first, modelled on ServiceMaintenanceServiceTests.cs:116-163 (the existing reset tests). Out of scope: the repo-wide ISessionScoped mechanism and the 22 singleton CampaignBehaviors (COMP-02): list them as the follow-up with their evidence.

plans.title: Cut the warg behaviour tree's per-tick resolves, allocations and native wrapper churn
plans.brief: FINDINGS seed F4, PERF-L4-03, PERF-L4-04 (lane-4), and the June harvest's PERF-06 allocation half and PERF-07 (triage-A heading lines 183 and 193, both STILL_VALID after the checker), all CONFIRMED. Full text: lane-4.findings.md; verdicts: verify-a-batch-06.md, verify-a-batch-07.md, triage-check.md (L193). plans.title: Stamp a dirty-tree flag into every build and a structured build field into every crash bundle
plans.brief: FINDINGS DX-L6-04 (lane-6) and seed F7 as corrected, CONFIRMED. Full text: lane-6.findings.md DX-L6-04; verdict: verify-b-batch-04.md. FACTS: Directory.Build.props:23-24 sets InformationalVersion to build.<UTC stamp>; the .NET SDK appends +<git SHA> at build time, so the live log shows '[BuildStamp] TAOM=v2.0.0.0 build.20260923-184249Z+c79a585218ad...' (FileLogger.cs:45-49, SubModule.cs:119-126), and the crash zip already carries that log (CrashBundleWriter.cs:17,46,87-95; ProcessEnvironmentCollector.cs:39). Gaps: (1) no dirty-tree marker: a build of uncommitted work carries HEAD's SHA and looks clean (21 dirty compiled-input paths existed in the main tree during the audit); (2) the crash bundle's structured identity (IdentityCollector.cs:13-25 / IdentitySnapshot) has no build-stamp field, so triage must read the log tail; (3) /release packages whatever DLL is built, so a release can ship uncommitted code (read .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md, docs/reference/release-process.md and tools/package_release.py). DIRECTION: an MSBuild target that appends .dirty (or .nogit when git is unavailable) to SourceRevisionId from a scoped 'git status --porcelain' over compiled inputs, verified by building twice (clean worktree, then with a touched file) and reading the assembly's InformationalVersion; a TaomBuild field in IdentitySnapshot and its renderers (TDD); /release rebuilds at the tag in a clean worktree and package_release.py refuses a DLL whose stamp is dirty or does not match the tag (--require-build). The target names InitializeSourceControlInformation / AddSourceRevisionToInformationalVersion are UNVERIFIED: the plan must have the executor confirm them against the installed SDK's Microsoft.NET targets (dotnet --version; grep the SDK folder) before relying on them, and STOP if they differ. Directory.Build.props is single-owner: in scope explicitly. /release skill edits need a CHANGELOG.md entry.
